title: Asymptotic Spectral Bounds under Odd-Girth Constraints
summary: Odd girth and the sum of the largest and smallest adjacency eigenvalues are two common indicators of how close a graph is to being bipartite. This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of this eigenvalue sum under odd-girth constraints. We study the associated abstract moment problem over finite real lists satisfying the vanishing odd-moment identities imposed by odd girth at least $g$ and the standard second-moment bound for graph spectra. We prove that the supremum of $(λ_1+λ_n)/n$ over these lists lies between $(1-o(1))(\log g)^2/g^3$ and $(10/7+o(1))(\log g)^2/g^3$ as $g\to\infty$…
